text.tspan: ?what does the sticky bit do on a directory

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
text.tspan: A sticky bit on a directory means only the file's owner (or root) can

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
text.tspan: delete or rename files inside it, even if others can write to it.
